channel.title: The Quant Scientist
channel.description: We test what traders believe. Al Brooks price action and popular trading strategies — coded in Python, backtested on real data, results shared honestly.

item.title: I Coded Al Brooks' Buy Signal Bar in Python and Tested It on 23,000 Bars
item.description: What happens when you translate Al Brooks' most-used bullish entry trigger into a strict mathematical formula and backtest it on real SPY data? The results are more nuanced than you'd expect.
